statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO workspaces(id,name,slug,created_by,created_at) SELECT :workspace_id, :name, :slug, :__user_id, :__now WHERE length(:workspace_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(:slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND :slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO workspace_members(workspace_id,user_id,role,joined_at) SELECT id,:__user_id,'owner',:__now FROM workspaces WHERE id = :workspace_id AND created_by = :__user_id AND created_at = :__now AND changes() > 0

INSERT INTO audit_log (id, workspace_id, actor_id, action, target_id, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :workspace_id, :__user_id, 'workspace_create', :workspace_id, :__now WHERE changes() > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members me WHERE me.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)
